condition_variants.variant_name: 晨霧繞斷崖、山巒若隱若現
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"崇德步道目前開放觀景平台 Camera Zone","subject":"Pacific Ocean + partially visible Qingshui Cliff / mountain + morning mist or low cloud"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 崇德步道／觀景平台合法可達；無現場封閉；不得把低能見度本身視為晨霧一定存在；拍攝點若進入白牆濃霧則不成立
condition_variants.required_conditions: 清晨或可見光時段；斷崖、山壁或海岸至少部分可辨；低能見度需有霧、低雲、高濕、低雲底、weather code 或北向多點霧訊號等至少一項氣象佐證；無明顯降雨。若拍攝點能見度低於 2.5 km，只能保留低信心候選，實際 Opportunity 分數封頂 68。北向多點資料缺失或不足時可回退 B81 單點低信心候選；若 330°/0°/30° 兩距離 proxy 資料完整且廣泛清楚、沒有任何目標區霧訊號，則否決 P03，不得把拍攝點局部低能見度當作斷崖晨霧。
condition_variants.boosters: 局部霧帶繞過山壁；弱風；日出前後斜射光；多項霧訊號一致
condition_variants.penalties: 拍攝平台本身白牆；斷崖與海岸完全不可辨；拍攝點能見度低於 2.5 km 的保守構圖可讀門檻；只有單一低能見度數值而缺乏其他霧訊號；北向 proxy 資料完整且廣泛清楚、未出現任何目標區霧訊號；大雨或強風。2.5 km 為規劃 guard，不代表斷崖實際距離。

viewpoints.note: Official evidence establishes morning mist as a real Qingshui Cliff scene and the currently open Chongde trail/viewing platforms as a Qingshui Cliff viewing area. This is an area anchor, not an exact tripod point.
viewpoints.name: 崇德步道目前開放觀景平台

opportunities.evidence_summary: Taroko/National Park official material documents Qingshui Cliff mornings with dense mist, mountains appearing and disappearing through mist, and cloud/mist changing as the sun rises. Runtime weather is used only to estimate when this verified scene may occur.

subject_evidence.note: 晨霧題材由清水斷崖官方地點資料直接證明，不由沿海地形或低能見度推論；B87/B88 runtime 額外要求高分推薦時拍攝點維持保守構圖可讀性，低於 2.5 km 時只保留低信心候選且最終 Opportunity 分數封頂 68。B93 區分 spatial data missing 與 negative spatial evidence：只有缺失／不足時保留 B81 fallback；北向 proxy 完整且廣泛清楚、沒有目標區霧訊號時否決晨霧候選。

condition_variants.variant_name: 海岸清晰＋北方山腰貼雲
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"七星潭月牙灣礫石海岸代表 Camera Zone","subject":"northward Pacific coast + partially visible Qingshui Cliff / Qingshui Mountain + terrain-attached low cloud"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 七星潭海岸拍攝點本身需保持可辨視野；不得把單點低雲量或高濕直接當作北方山區貼山雲；若拍攝點白牆、明顯降雨或北方山體完全不可辨則不成立
condition_variants.required_conditions: 可見光時段；七星潭海岸能見度可用。優先採北向至北北東多點山區 proxy 的直接低雲／高濕／能見度下降一致訊號；若格點未直接解析雲帶，只允許在海岸清楚、LCL 規劃級估算與多方位高地相交、且高地出現顯著能見度落差與至少少量低雲支持時形成低信心地形雲候選。
condition_variants.boosters: 拍攝點高能見度；北方山區低雲明顯高於海岸；雲帶跨多個距離樣本；弱風；山峰或斷崖仍部分露出；多方位高地與 LCL 估算交會且高地能見度顯著低於海岸。
condition_variants.penalties: 拍攝點低能見度或低雲過高；北方全部樣本近白牆；大雨；只有單一格點異常；山區與海岸條件沒有方向性差異；僅 LCL 低而缺乏高地能見度落差或低雲支持時不得成立。

viewpoints.note: Official evidence establishes Qixingtan as a northward viewing place for Qingshui Cliff / Qingshui Mountain; this coordinate remains a representative area anchor, not an exact tripod point.
viewpoints.name: 七星潭月牙灣礫石海岸代表機位

opportunities.evidence_summary: 交通部觀光署資料明確指出七星潭可遠眺清水斷崖；臺灣國家公園資料進一步描述從七星潭海岸隔海灣向北可見太平洋、清水斷崖與向上延伸的清水山，並記錄清水山山頂常聚積雲霧。這證明北望山海與山區雲帶是 Place-specific 可拍題材；runtime 只估計何時較可能出現海岸清晰、北方山區貼雲的方向性條件。

subject_evidence.note: 題材存在性由官方地點資料證明；B85 runtime 分成直接格點雲訊號與低信心地形雲 proxy。後者只用於格點解析度不足時的規劃候選，分數上限 78，且不得宣稱實際雲帶已被觀測。

viewpoints.note: Official 2026 stargazing service explicitly uses the Nishi-Hotakaguchi rooftop observation deck and Itadaki no Mori. Same summit Camera Zone as P01, but night access is event-only.

research_sources.authority: Niigata Prefecture Official Tourism — Mt. Yahiko
research_sources.supports: Mt. Yahiko summit area is a 634 m panoramic destination with views over Echigo Plain, the Sea of Japan and Sado Island; official material also identifies sunset, night view and starry-sky value.

research_sources.authority: Niigata Prefecture Official Tourism — Yahikoyama Summit Park
research_sources.supports: Yahikoyama Summit Park contains the approximately 100 m rotating Panorama Tower and officially supports Sea of Japan/Sado panorama, sunset and night-view outcomes; Panorama Tower closes for winter from around November 6.

research_sources.authority: Niigata Prefecture Official Tourism — Yahikoyama Skyline
research_sources.supports: Skyline access to the summit area is officially published as 05:00-23:00 from April through November, subject to residual-snow conditions; road access is therefore seasonal and not equivalent to year-round guaranteed summit access.

research_sources.authority: Niigata Prefecture Official Tourism — 2026 Night View & Stargazing Cruise
research_sources.supports: 2026 special night ropeway service is limited to Aug 11-12, Aug 14-16 and Sep 19-23, with ascent service from 18:00 to 20:30 and final descent at 21:00; adverse-weather cancellation is announced by 16:00.

research_sources.authority: Yahiko Tourism Association Official — Summit Station / Summit Park
research_sources.supports: Official local tourism confirms Panorama Tower as a 360-degree summit-area observation facility and notes separate seasonal closure/maintenance semantics.

research_sources.authority: Cross-checked Panorama Tower mapped Geo URI
research_sources.supports: Mapped Panorama Tower POI provides a cross-check coordinate of approximately 37.710125, 138.809994 for the summit-park Camera Zone; it is used as a zone anchor, not a mandatory tripod position.

opportunities.name_zh: 彌彥山頂公園・越後平野與日本海全景
opportunities.best_time: 山頂區可合法到達的白天可見光時段（景點當地時間／JST）
opportunities.best_season: 全年皆有景觀價值，但道路、纜車與塔體營運具有不同季節／臨時限制；不得把單一路線營運狀態當成整個山頂必然可達

condition_variants.variant_name: 山頂公園／Panorama Tower・越後平野、日本海與佐渡全景

condition_variants.required_conditions: 越後平野與日本海主要景觀可辨；能見度足夠；低雲／濃霧未嚴重遮蔽遠景
condition_variants.boosters: 空氣透明度高可增加佐渡島與遠山可見度；春季水田、夏季綠意、秋季紅葉、冬季雪景僅在實際存在時加分
condition_variants.penalties: 山頂所有合理進出路線不可用；濃霧／低雲遮蔽；強降水；能見度過低

viewpoints.note: Official prefectural and local tourism sources identify the summit park / Panorama Tower area as the 360-degree panorama destination. Coordinate is a cross-checked Panorama Tower POI anchor within that public Camera Zone.

opportunities.best_season: 官方資料明確支持日本海夕日；實際可達時段仍依季節道路／纜車／步行條件判定

condition_variants.variant_name: 山頂公園・日本海西向夕日

opportunities.best_season: 僅官方當年度指定活動日；2026 為 8/11–12、8/14–16、9/19–23，不得推論未發布年份

research_sources.authority: Setagaya City Official — Todoroki Valley Park
research_sources.supports: The riverside path reopened on 2026-03-24; visitors are told not to enter after dark, to stay away from the river during heavy rain, and the current notice says photography is not being accepted because of expected congestion.

research_sources.authority: Setagaya City Official — Tokyo-designated Scenic Place Todoroki Valley
research_sources.supports: Official scenic-place description identifies Golf Bridge and the deep green ravine character, plus seasonal cherry blossom, evergreen woodland and autumn foliage; Fudo waterfall is separately documented.

research_sources.authority: Tokyu Corporation Official — Todoroki Area Guide
research_sources.supports: Official railway-area guide identifies Golf Bridge as a symbolic red bridge whose contrast with the ravine greenery is photogenic.

research_sources.authority: Cross-checked Golf Bridge coordinate
research_sources.supports: Mapped Golf Bridge coordinate 35.607857, 139.646545 is used as the Camera Zone anchor; it is a bridge/entrance-area reference rather than a mandatory tripod point.

opportunities.name_zh: 等等力溪谷・Golf Bridge 紅橋與綠蔭溪谷
opportunities.best_time: 白天（景點當地時間／JST；官方明示天黑後不要進入）
opportunities.best_season: 全年綠蔭景觀；櫻花與秋色只作季節加分，不視為每日保證

condition_variants.variant_name: Golf Bridge 紅橋・谷澤川與綠蔭溪谷
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"等々力渓谷 ゴルフ橋／谷沢川入口 Camera Zone","subject":"red Golf Bridge + Yazawa River ravine + green woodland"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 等々力渓谷公園合法開放；僅白天進入；豪雨時遠離河道；官方目前『撮影は受け付けておりません』公告解除或範圍被正式釐清前，不啟用攝影推薦評分
condition_variants.required_conditions: 紅色Golf Bridge與溪谷綠蔭／谷澤川脈絡可辨；若日後解除拍攝限制，仍需能見度與降水條件可用
condition_variants.boosters: 柔和散射光；新綠；秋色；雨後但非豪雨且步道安全時的濕潤植被質感
condition_variants.penalties: 官方拍攝不受理公告仍有效；天黑後；豪雨／河水暴漲風險；步道壅擠；強降水

viewpoints.note: Setagaya official material identifies Golf Bridge as the Todoroki Valley entrance landmark; Tokyu explicitly describes the red bridge/green-ravine contrast as photogenic. Coordinate is a cross-checked bridge anchor, not a fixed shooting position.

viewpoints.geometry_note: Golf Bridge與谷澤川入口周邊合法公共動線；不宣稱單一腳架點，且目前官方拍攝不受理公告未解除前不作推薦。

research_sources.authority: Japan National Tourism Organization (JNTO) — Hagi Castle Town
research_sources.supports: Official national tourism guidance identifies Kikuya Yokocho as one of the most picturesque parts of Hagi Castle Town, highlighting its cross-hatched walls and the iconic summer oranges over historic walls.

research_sources.authority: Hagi City — Historic Townscape Preservation
research_sources.supports: Hagi City documents Kikuya Yokocho, Iseya Yokocho and Edoya Yokocho as the preserved castle-town street network, with namako-wall storehouses, gates and earthen/plaster walls forming the historic streetscape.

research_sources.authority: Hagi City — Castle Town Walking Course
research_sources.supports: Official city walking route explicitly includes Kikuya Yokocho and uses the Kikuya Residence namako-wall streetscape as representative visual material.

research_sources.authority: Hagi Tourism Association — 2026 Hagi Bamboo Lamp Festival
research_sources.supports: Official 2026 event dates are Oct 9-11, 18:00-21:00; about 2,000 bamboo lanterns illuminate the historic castle-town streets and an official photo spot is part of the event.

research_sources.authority: Hagi Tourism Association — 2026 Castle Town Night Tour
research_sources.supports: The official Oct 9-11 night-tour route explicitly follows the bamboo-lantern-lit Onarimichi and Kikuya Yokocho, confirming Kikuya Yokocho as part of the night event route.

research_sources.authority: MapFan — Kikuya Yokocho mapped street POI
research_sources.supports: Mapped Kikuya Yokocho coordinate 34.4119363, 131.3932271 provides the representative navigation/Camera-Zone anchor for the historic lane.

research_sources.authority: Geotagged photographed Kikuya Yokocho camera position
research_sources.supports: A photographed point on Kikuya Yokocho at approximately 34.411264, 131.393172 cross-checks that real camera positions lie along the mapped lane rather than at the legacy city-centre coordinate.

opportunities.name_zh: 萩城下町・菊屋橫町白壁與江戶街景
opportunities.best_time: 白天可見光時段（景點當地時間／JST）
opportunities.best_season: 全年；夏蜜柑、秋季和服活動等只在實際存在時作畫面加分，不是基本 Outcome 硬條件

condition_variants.variant_name: 菊屋橫町・白壁／海鼠壁與歷史街巷

condition_variants.hard_gates: 菊屋橫町公共街道可合法步行；白天可見光有效；不得進入私人住宅或阻礙居民／行人動線
condition_variants.required_conditions: 菊屋橫町白壁、海鼠壁、門與歷史街巷脈絡清楚可辨；無足以妨礙步行與手持攝影的強降水

condition_variants.penalties: 強降水；積水／惡劣天候；人流過度壅擠；越界進入私人範圍

viewpoints.note: Official Hagi/JNTO sources identify Kikuya Yokocho as the representative picturesque historic lane. The anchor is the mapped street POI, cross-checked against geotagged photographs along the lane; it is not a fixed tripod point.

viewpoints.geometry_note: 菊屋橫町約500公尺歷史街巷公共動線；可沿街前後移動尋找白壁、海鼠壁、門與夏蜜柑構圖，不宣稱單一腳架位置。

opportunities.evidence_summary: Location-specific sources describe actual morning mist/haze at Hualien Liyu Lake, including Forestry and Nature Conservation Agency imagery text ('晨霧氤氳' / '煙嵐飄渺') and documented photographer observations of winter morning mist. Runtime visibility/humidity thresholds are forecast proxies, not geomorphology-derived proof.

subject_evidence.note: 霧景題材不是由湖盆地形或高濕條件推論；花東縱谷國家風景區管理處明確描述鯉魚潭清晨霧氣為拍攝場景，林業及自然保育署官方影像資料亦記錄晨霧氤氳與煙嵐飄渺。

research_sources.authority: U.S. National Park Service — Qizhjeh Vena (Lake Clark)
research_sources.supports: NPS describes Lake Clark as a glacial lake surrounded by mountains, publishes Port Alsworth at 60°11.842N, 154°19.357W, and displays an official aurora photograph from Port Alsworth.

research_sources.authority: U.S. National Park Service — Port Alsworth
research_sources.supports: NPS identifies Port Alsworth on Lake Clark as the park field-headquarters community and notes it is not connected to a road system; most visitors arrive by small plane.

research_sources.authority: U.S. National Park Service — Lake Clark Places To Go
research_sources.supports: NPS identifies Lake Clark itself as a major scenic/recreation destination with Port Alsworth on the southern shore.

opportunities.best_season: 全年自然場景成立；雪景、倒影與秋色只作現況加分

research_sources.authority: Alaska Division of Parks and Outdoor Recreation — Independence Mine State Historical Park
research_sources.supports: Alaska State Parks identifies Independence Mine as a historic gold-mining camp with historical features and trails, publishes Mile 17.3 Hatcher Pass Road access, and states pedestrian visitors can access the mine after upper-lot gate hours from Independence Bowl parking.

research_sources.authority: Alaska Division of Parks and Outdoor Recreation — Hatcher Pass East Management Area
research_sources.supports: Alaska State Parks documents the mountainous Talkeetna Range setting, seasonal Hatcher Pass road limitations, and winter closure of the last mile to Independence Mine for vehicles.

research_sources.authority: Alaska Division of Parks and Outdoor Recreation — Park Condition Reports
research_sources.supports: Alaska State Parks publishes current Hatcher Pass / Independence Mine condition reports, demonstrating that road/trail safety is a dynamic state independent of favorable photography weather.

opportunities.name_zh: Independence Mine・歷史礦區＋Talkeetna Mountains高山景觀
opportunities.best_time: 公園／Independence Bowl當下可安全到達的白天時段；upper-lot gate關閉時依官方規則由下方停車區步行
opportunities.best_season: 全年可有不同形式的步行／冬季活動，但道路、雪況、雪崩與停車可達性需依官方當下條件
